limitations: No native session-start, session-end, stop or failure hooks; the plugin injects Host Context when a command executes or a method skill loads.
Telemetry and plugin-update adapters are unsupported; HelixHarness scripts return unsupported_host or continue_silently while business work continues.
OpenCode has no native plan tool; update_plan falls back to the current Feature tasks.md.
Project hooks are unsupported because OpenCode has no project settings hook contract; Init uses AGENTS.md and settings_file is null.
Workspace Apply RepoJobs use delegation_policy=may_delegate; OpenCode defaults to subagent depth 1, so set experimental.subagent_depth to at least 2.
The d-d2c Claude skill-scoped Stop/PreToolUse guards are not active; run that skill in its no-hook/--bare semantics without claiming guard enforcement.
